project_type: Full-stack TypeScript app: Node/Express REST API backend with better-sqlite3 persistence + React (Vite) merchant dashboard frontend. Greenfield build in an empty git repo.
build_system: npm workspaces monorepo (root package.json with workspaces: server, web). tsc for backend typecheck/build, Vite for frontend build.
test_framework: Vitest for backend unit + integration tests (supertest for HTTP e2e). Frontend build check only.
build_command: npm run build (builds server tsc + web vite)
test_command: npm test (runs vitest in server workspace)
verification_instructions: 1) npm install at root. 2) npm run build. 3) npm test (vitest). 4) npm run seed then npm run dev, hit /api/dashboard and /api/customers to confirm 7 seeded scenarios return with correct RECOVER/INTERVENE/RESTRICT/SUSPEND decisions.
snapshot_or_generated_files: SQLite DB file (data/app.db) is generated by seed/migrations and must be gitignored. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: npm install at repo root (npm workspaces). Copy .env.example to .env (app runs without OPENROUTER_API_KEY in deterministic demo mode). npm run seed to populate demo data.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET so npm installs are fine. App MUST run fully in demo mode with NO OpenRouter key (deterministic fallback text). Razorpay adapter runs in simulation/test mode by default; no live Razorpay account required. No external DB server (SQLite file).
contribution_requirements: No secrets committed. .gitignore must exclude .env, node_modules, dist/build, data/*.db. .env.example provided with OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL and RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET placeholders. No overstated AI/ML/Razorpay claims in README.
key_patterns: Deterministic core: pure functions for classifier, weighted+decayed risk scoring with confidence, behavioural pattern detectors, decision engine (RECOVER/INTERVENE/RESTRICT/SUSPEND), access state machine (ACTIVE->RECOVERY->GRACE->RESTRICTED->SUSPENDED->BLACKLIST_RECOMMENDED). Adapters (Razorpay, OpenRouter) behind interfaces, injected, with simulation/fallback modes. Audit trail persisted for every decision. Explainable output: every decision returns evidence[] with human-readable reasons.
directory_structure: server/ = backend (domain, engine, adapters, db, api, seed, test). web/ = React dashboard. data/ = sqlite db (gitignored). Root holds workspace package.json, README, .env.example, .gitignore.
